Correct = the unit is a caption/credit of that figure; wrong = it is not; unclear = partly (for example a credit line that credits the picture and quoted text).

reference_paragraph_evidence: Of the book 4 links the derived gold tags as non-caption, 84 have text that occurs as a reference figure title or caption (step12_links.py field text_in_reference_caption); in the sampled cases the phrase occurs in the XML only inside a figure title while the derived gold maps the PDF tokens to unrelated para units on the same page (question and list paragraphs). This is a derived-gold alignment error on those tokens, not a converter link error.
